title: fix: explain contested-path holds in commit reports
description: Producer split for task-c2a900aa5107479aa4c630f1b3837ed0. Recorded option B: preserve existing contested-path safety/attribution predicate, add working remediation to reporting/docs. Original parent owns twin launcher held banners, twin postflight regressions, scripts/CLAUDE.md and final integration/hardening. In recordCommit.ts recognize validated skipped entries with exact MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED or MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_UNTOUCHED(<peer>) code shape; append bounded held-path/remedy line to task-channel report and trigger existing rate-limited governors alert even for committed/nothing with zero unattributed paths. Use skipped, not contested trailers: a contested path may have landed via TOOL, and must not be falsely reported held. Preserve ledger/path unions/duplicate semantics; chat errors remain best-effort. Remedy: declare_files does not override contest; after verifying bytes are this task's and coordinating any live peer, an owning assignee's landing session must produce a wrapper-observed successful editing-tool witness (currently Claude stream-collected Edit/Write, not shell writes), or legitimately complete/archive the stale peer before retry. Never claim declaration, plain unblocking, or arbitrary shell touch alone solves it. Update declareFiles.ts tool description/new-path message with contest caveat, docs/MCP_SERVER.md corresponding contract passages, and docs/roles/governor.md cheat sheet without loosening safety. Tests in recordCommit.test.ts cover alert/code classification/truncation/repeat window/chat failure and declare_files output caveat. Own exactly those five files. No new wire field/schema or wrapper edits. Dependencies serialize shared MCP docs only. Root verification: (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test) && npm run lint.
definitionOfDone: A held contested skipped entry produces bounded actionable task-channel and rate-limited governors messages for committed and nothing outcomes without requiring unattributedPaths; regression tests assert both.
Contested-but-landed trailer entries, unrelated/near-match skip codes, and malformed skipped entries do not produce false held alerts; repeat-window and chat-error behavior remain compatible.
declare_files still unions paths exactly as before, but description/success prose and docs/MCP_SERVER.md accurately state declaration does not bypass contested holds.
docs/roles/governor.md states the verified-assignee-session TOOL or legitimate terminal-peer remedy, not declaration/plain unblocking/shell touch as a guaranteed bypass.
Fresh (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test) && npm run lint exits 0; attribution decision and state-file/tool input contracts are unchanged.

comments.author: architect-1520cc31
comments.content: Important policy nuance for reporting tests: MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED means strict attribution.contested=skip; a TOOL witness does NOT bypass it. Only MOE_ATTR_CONTESTED_UNTOUCHED(peer) under skip-untouched can suggest the verified successful editing-tool witness. For strict skip say resolve/legitimately finish the peer before retry. Never imply a shell touch or mere unblocking works, and never change the policy as remediation.
